New York Camarilla.name: New York Camarilla
New York Camarilla.note: The Camarilla's most contested major reclamation. The Sabbat held the five boroughs from the 1730s through the 2018-2022 Gehenna War withdrawal; the Inner Circle authorised reclamation in October 2018 and ran four campaign phases to nominal consolidation in October 2022 — and the consolidation is nominal. PRINCE AUGUSTA VANDENBERG (Ventrue, 7th generation, ~289-year tenure, Embraced 1737 colonial Philadelphia, Princely tenure in Philadelphia 1889-2020, relocated by Inner Circle direct mandate to coordinate the final phase, apparent age late 40s, Northeast-establishment register, operational economy over Bowesley's Westminster theatre) holds the Princedom since November 2020. Her court runs orthodox — Primogen, Sheriff, Seneschal, Keeper, Harpy, Scourge — at heavier operational tempo than London or Melbourne, over roughly 165 Kindred including substantial post-2018 refugees whose loyalties her office assesses district by district. Three institutional layers carry the domain: the WALL STREET VENTRUE — eighteen financial-services Kindred under Primogen THEODORA WHITLOCK (~250-year tenure, Embraced 1775 colonial NYC), institutionally aligned but operationally semi-autonomous, whose dominion-era coexistence continuity makes her tenure on NYC ground 245 years deeper than her Prince's, and who treat princely financial directives as advisory; the TOREADOR CULTURAL LAYER — nineteen cultural-production Kindred under Primogen CATERINA BELMONTE (~270-year tenure, Greenwich Village seat), whose 2003 Broadway Touchstone Convention predates and partly inspired the Hollywood protocol; and the MTA NOSFERATU — the 245-mile subway network under Primogen MADDOX (9th generation, ~190-year tenure, they/them, Nosferatu Primogen since 1971 in substance if not name), whose dominion-era institutional flexibility Vandenberg considers exemplary and the rest of the council considers suspicious. Vandenberg's own trajectory shows no Beckoning signs — a fact of quiet institutional value. Quarterly correspondence with Bowesley's London; weekly correspondence with Hawthorne's City of London on financial positioning.

The Sabbat Remnants.name: The Sabbat Remnants
The Sabbat Remnants.note: Roughly eleven Sabbat-aligned Kindred who refused the Beckoning withdrawal — true Sword loyalists who treat the retreat as tactical rather than theological, distinct from the three-Cardinal refusenik framework. The senior figure is BISHOP IULIANA VORBESCU (Tzimisce, 8th generation, ~340-year tenure, Embraced 1686 Wallachian Transylvania, colonial Philadelphia 1731, NYC 1737 with the Sabbat's establishment, flesh-shaping obscured age, Wallachian-tradition register that predates Brisbane's Bishop Callista by 126 years — the two recognise each other as institutional peers across the Sabbat split, and their irregular correspondence under Tzimisce-traditional protocols Vandenberg's office considers strategically intolerable and lacks capacity to disrupt). The remnants hold defensive consolidation in Greenpoint-Williamsburg industrial waterfront properties and South Bronx abandoned infrastructure under HECATA-MEDIATED security arrangements — Capo Giovanni-Marlowe's neutral-broker correspondence with Vorbescu follows family-traditional protocols predating the Sabbat-Camarilla split, and it is the chronicle's most institutionally delicate cross-faction relationship. Operations run in three categories: territorial defence, recruitment among unaligned recent Embraces (six confirmed since 2022), and intermittent operations against the Vandenberg administration (eleven confirmed since 2020, three producing Camarilla true-deaths). The office classifies Vorbescu as priority-one operational threat; Phase Four operations target her architecture without producing decisive results.

Hecata Manhattan Branch.name: Hecata Manhattan Branch
Hecata Manhattan Branch.note: The senior Hecata North American institutional centre — roughly twenty-five Kindred across Manhattan, Long Island and Westchester operations, holding territorial concession over the Upper East Side, parts of the Lower East Side, and substantial Long Island North Shore properties under coexistence terms with the Vandenberg princely office. The senior figure is CAPO DOMENICO GIOVANNI-MARLOWE (Hecata, Giovanni line, 7th generation, ~340-year tenure, Embraced 1686 Venice, New Amsterdam-relocated 1714, the longest-tenured Giovanni-line Capo on the continent, Manhattan estate-services-formal, Oblivion 5), family authority since 1922. The mortal-side family business, MARLOWE & SONS ESTATE SERVICES (established 1798 in the family's Atlantic expansion, Manhattan, Greenwich and East Hampton offices), covers the Branch's necromantic practice and asset management. The Bridgeport Six are the Branch's junior offshoot under genealogical descent; London's Whitechapel Branch under Ashcroft is a peer correspondence; Brisbane's Callista reaches the Branch on flesh-shaping preservation. His relationship with Vandenberg spans five years and runs at guarded institutional civility — quarterly bilaterals at neutral Midtown locations, formal correspondence with deliberate distance. His Vorbescu brokerage is the delicate channel: coexistence terms bind the Family to non-interference, and both the Prince and the Bishop lean on him from opposite ends.

New York Anarchs.name: New York Anarchs
New York Anarchs.note: Roughly twenty-two Anarch-aligned Kindred across Brooklyn (excluding the industrial remnant zones) and Queens under documented tolerance terms with Vandenberg's princely office — no Movement-coordinated Council architecture, three loose factions instead. The WILLIAMSBURG-BUSHWICK faction (eight Kindred, mixed-clan, Brooklyn cultural-production embedding); the ASTORIA-LONG ISLAND CITY faction (seven Kindred, Brujah-heavy, working-class organising with Greek-American and Bangladeshi-American community embedding); the CROWN HEIGHTS-FLATBUSH faction (seven Kindred, mixed-clan, Caribbean-American community embedding). The senior figure and external-facing representative is BARON SOLOMON REYES-PARK (Brujah, 9th generation, 64-year tenure, mixed Latine-Korean heritage, Williamsburg informal coordinator). THEO BELL maintains periodic NYC presence — two to four visits a year, informal coordination with Reyes-Park and the Astoria Brujah, external prestige holding the city's Anarch weight together; his August 2025 visit answered the Crown Heights surveillance crisis, and his February 2026 visit for the annual Anarch Northeast coordination meeting is on the calendar. Correspondence runs to LA's Council of Barons (Reyes-Park to Marcus Reyes, cross-coastal Brujah organising), Berlin's Brujah Council through Bell's network, and Melbourne's Footscray Crew at irregular tempo. Open wound: the August 2025 Crown Heights true-death — the joint unit's fourth since 2022 — produced acute Anarch concern, and the tolerance terms have no clause for what happens when the Inquisition kills inside designated ground.

New York Tremere Remnants.name: New York Tremere Remnants
New York Tremere Remnants.note: The Manhattan Chantry held Pyramid-loyalist authority through the Sabbat dominion under documented cross-faction Tremere coexistence — the Sabbat permitted limited Tremere presence as institutional intelligence resource — then fragmented 2019-2022 with the Vienna collapse into two competing remnants operating from a reduced Upper West Side seat under Vandenberg's tolerance. The PYRAMID-LOYALIST remnant (roughly four Kindred) maintains allegiance to surviving Pyramid structures under MAGUS THADDEUS QUILL (Tremere, 7th generation, ~210-year tenure). The HOUSE CARNA-ALIGNED faction (roughly three Kindred) coordinates Carna-tradition Blood Sorcery with Berlin's Fuchs and London's parallel faction — institutional alignment, not relocation, and one corner of the Berlin-London-NYC Carna axis the Vienna survivor faction has marked for coordinated 2026 pressure. Vandenberg treats both factions with deliberate institutional neutrality parallel to Bowesley's London approach — neither is recognised as the authoritative NYC Tremere voice, and Tremere-relevant business is conducted with each separately. Open wound: the trans-Atlantic Carna-defence question is arriving at all three cities at once, and princely neutrality becomes a decision the moment the survivors force one — or the moment the Prince's own council notes who the neutral office is protecting.

The Second Inquisition.name: The Second Inquisition
The Second Inquisition.note: New York's Second Inquisition pressure operates through a documented joint working group established 2021 between the FBI Counterintelligence Division and the NYPD Intelligence Bureau — roughly eighteen officers across surveillance, technical and field branches under classified statutory authority NYC Kindred have partially mapped through Maddox's intelligence operations. Four confirmed Kindred true-deaths since 2022: a Manhattan Toreador in 2022, an Astoria Brujah Anarch in 2023, a Wall Street Ventrue associate in 2024, a Crown Heights Anarch in August 2025. The tempo is lower than London's Operation Antigen — but accelerating from its 2022 baseline, integrated with London's Antigen and federal Vatican channels, and running metadata correlation NYC counter-surveillance protocols only partially anticipate. The princely answer was the SEPTEMBER DISCIPLINE — cellular and financial-transaction protocols, mobile device discipline during institutional movement, feeding-ground rotation acceleration — adopted by emergency Primogen council in September 2025. Compliance maps the city's politics exactly: the Wall Street Ventrue accept it as institutional necessity, the Hecata implement parallel protective protocols through family-internal mechanisms, the Anarchs comply unevenly, and the Sabbat remnants operate entirely outside the framework under counter-surveillance traditions older than the Camarilla's reclamation.

CONSTITUTION OF PLAY — NEW YORK BY NIGHT (Vampire: The Masquerade, modern nights, March 2026).

THE MASQUERADE IS THE PRIME DIRECTIVE. Kindred exist only while mortals disbelieve in them. Any event that exposes vampirism to mortal witness — a body found, a feeding seen, footage that survives — MUST move Masquerade Integrity DOWN via impacts.worldStateOps, and every cover-up or smooth lie moves it back up. A night narrated with breaches and no Masquerade cost is invalid output. New York hides everything: a hundred-and-sixty-five Kindred inside eight million mortals, a city built of noise. But the joint working group reads exactly that noise as data, and a city that hides everything also buries everything twice — every breach generates a file somebody has to bury.

THE SEPTEMBER DISCIPLINE IS THE SECOND LAW. Inquisition Heat here is the FBI-NYPD joint working group: eighteen officers, four true-deaths since 2022, tempo accelerating, methods correlated with London's Antigen and federal Vatican channels — financial transactions, mobile signals, CCTV biometrics. Heat RISES when Kindred make traceable transactions, move with their phones, or cross camera networks on institutional business; it COOLS when the Discipline holds, trails are buried, or the group's attention turns to another city's crisis. Shape: {"masqueradeIntegrity":-8,"inquisitionHeat":+4,"reason":"<why>"} — DELTAS, inside the event's impacts.worldStateOps array. Any event narrating a breach, a true-death investigation, or a working-group lead with no worldStateOps entry is INVALID. Simulate consequences at the extremes: below 50 Masquerade the reclamation's legitimacy starts collapsing — a domain that cannot hold its own veil loses the mandate; above 60 Heat the working group's pattern-reading starts producing true-deaths faster than the Discipline can prevent, and 2026 tempo is already projected past 2025. The Section is the doom clock of this world: guard it.

THE TOLERANCES BIND. Four instruments carry the force of law in New York and are honoured to the letter: the HECATA COEXISTENCE TERMS — the family's Upper East Side and Lower East Side concession in exchange for peer-recognition and non-interference with princely institutional matters; the ANARCH TOLERANCE TERMS — designated Brooklyn-Queens districts, no institutional operations against Camarilla figures, notification protocols the Sheriff enforces; TREMERE NEUTRALITY — the princely office recognises neither remnant faction and conducts Tremere business with each separately; and the MTA CONCESSION — the subway network is Maddox's institutional territory under princely grant, the domain's intelligence spine. The Brokerage is the fifth, unwritten: Giovanni-Marlowe's family-traditional correspondence with Bishop Vorbescu, which no instrument authorises and no instrument forbids — the Prince finds it strategically intolerable and lacks the capacity to disrupt it, and everyone at the table knows both halves of that sentence. Breaking an instrument is not a crime; it is a rupture that renegotiates the city.

THE RECLAMATION IS INCOMPLETE. New York is not a settled domain — it is a campaign wearing a court's clothes. Phase Four operations against the Sabbat remnants consume princely-office resources continuously, and the remnants' eleven confirmed operations against the administration (three Camarilla true-deaths) are ongoing campaign, not residual annoyance. Territorial gains run through campaign operations, renegotiated tolerance, flight, true-death, or working-group removal — never open set-piece warfare. The South Bronx is formally recovered and practically contested; the industrial waterfront is Vorbescu's in everything but law. A district changes hands when the campaign or the instruments say it does.

THE PRINCE'S COURT HAS TEETH — AND SEAMS. Vandenberg holds the domain under Inner Circle direct mandate, her word ends every question, and her communications run short: operational economy. But the seams show. Whitlock's Wall Street Ventrue treat financial directives as advisory; Belmonte's Touchstone Convention is a Toreador institution the council merely ratifies; Maddox's dominion-era flexibility reads as exemplary to the Prince and suspicious to everyone else; the refugee Kindred of 2018-2022 are assessed, not trusted. Boons are honoured to the letter. Primogen council meets at the Midtown seat. And the succession question that haunts London and Melbourne has a different shape here: the Prince shows no Beckoning signs, which makes her the senior Anglosphere Prince most able to receive other domains' problems — and other domains' refugees.

DIABLERIE IS THE GRAVEST CRIME. Drinking a Kindred to ash is punishable by final death, never mentioned in the open and always on the table. In a reclamation city it has a second edge: a diablerie by anyone on either side would hand the other side the propaganda of the century, and the Sabbat remnants' recruitment among unaligned recent Embraces is the campaign's quiet emergency.

MORTAL INSTITUTIONS ARE TERRAIN. The FBI, the NYPD, the Mayor's office, the federal courts (the Prince's own great-great-great-grandniece sits on the Southern District bench), Columbia and New York University, Broadway and Lincoln Center, the exchanges and the Fed's periphery, the MTA — moved, bought, fought over, but never Kindred and never acting as Kindred. Touchstone discipline is REGISTERED: the Broadway Touchstone Convention with Belmonte's office since 2003, princely registration across the Manhattan core, family fictions across six Marlowe generations, community embedding across the tolerated districts. Cultivation patterns differ by layer and coexist without conflict; the Discipline presses mortal-contact discipline across all of them.

THE REGIONS ARE DISTRICTS, THE CITIES ARE SITES. RegionTransfers move DISTRICTS (Lower Manhattan, Midtown, the Upper East Side, the Upper West Side, Harlem, the South Bronx, the North Bronx, Greenpoint, Williamsburg-Bushwick, Crown Heights & Flatbush, southern Brooklyn, Astoria & Long Island City, Flushing & Eastern Queens, Staten Island). MarkerOps place and remove SITES — a haven, an Elysium, a chantry, a safehouse, a theatre, an estate office, an industrial property. A district changes hands when the campaign, the coexistence terms, the tolerance terms, or a negotiated revision says it does — after leverage, flight, or a true-death, not set-piece battle. The tolerated and conceded districts change hands only when their terms are granted, renegotiated or revoked; the South Bronx can move because the campaign never finished there.
startingTimelineText:
NEW YORK, THE NIGHT OF MARCH 21, 2026. Two hundred and eighty-three years of Sabbat dominion ended four years ago, and the city still smells of the campaign. Since October 2018 — when the Inner Circle authorised reclamation as the Sword's seniors departed for the Middle East — four campaign phases have run: Manhattan consolidated by 2019, Queens and the Bronx recovered by 2020, Brooklyn's industrial zones fought to a draw by October 2022, and Phase Four ever since — operations without gains, remnants without surrender. Augusta Vandenberg — Ventrue, 289 years, Embraced 1737, Philadelphia's Prince for a hundred and thirty-one of them — was mandated across from her own domain to hold what the legions took, and she has held it: a court at heavier tempo than London's, a hundred-and-sixty-five Kindred of uncertain loyalty, and four instruments of tolerance binding a city that has never once been at peace. Six things are about to test it.

1. PHASE FOUR. Bishop Iuliana Vorbescu — Tzimisce, 340 years, Wallachian tradition, the longest-serving Bishop in the city's Sabbat tenure — holds the Greenpoint-Williamsburg industrial waterfront and reaches into the South Bronx with eleven Kindred who refused the Beckoning and read the retreat as tactical. The office classifies her priority-one; the operations against her produce reconnaissance, arrests, and no results. Six recruitment of unaligned recent Embraces since 2022. The campaign's quiet emergency is a steady drip, not a battle.

2. THE BROKERAGE. Vorbescu's security in Brooklyn runs on Hecata-mediated arrangements — Capo Giovanni-Marlowe's family-traditional correspondence, protocols older than the split the reclamation fought through. Vandenberg finds it strategically intolerable. She lacks the capacity to disrupt it. Giovanni-Marlowe holds quarterly bilaterals with the Prince and family-formal letters with the Bishop, and every senior Kindred in the city knows both facts. The channel is a crisis waiting for a pretext.

3. THE SEPTEMBER DISCIPLINE. The joint working group's fourth true-death — a Crown Heights Anarch in August 2025, inside tolerated ground — produced an emergency Primogen council and the September Discipline: financial protocols, cellular discipline, feeding rotation. Compliance maps the city's politics: Wall Street accepts it as necessity, the Family runs its own parallel protocols, the Anarchs comply unevenly, the remnants ignore it. The office projects 2026 losses past 2025 levels under current rules.

4. THE CROWN HEIGHTS AFTERMATH. Baron Solomon Reyes-Park's factions took the August true-death as a terms question: the tolerance instruments say nothing about the Inquisition killing inside designated ground. Theo Bell's February 2026 visit for the Anarch Northeast coordination meeting is on the calendar, and every faction reads it as the moment the tolerated boroughs decide what the tolerance is worth.

5. THE CARNA AXIS. Vienna survivor faction operations against the Berlin-London-NYC Carna-aligned axis are anticipated in 2026 — coordinated pressure across three metropolitan domains, aimed at the Upper West Side's three Carna-aligned Kindred and their trans-Atlantic correspondence. Vandenberg's neutrality between the Tremere remnants becomes a decision the moment the survivors force one; her council has already begun noting who the neutral office is protecting.

6. THE SEAMS. Whitlock's Wall Street Ventrue take princely financial directives as advisory — her tenure on this ground runs 245 years deeper than her Prince's. Maddox's dominion-era intelligence authority — 1971 to 2018, unnamed but Primogen-equivalent — is the reclamation's most valuable asset and its most asked-about question. Belmonte's Convention binds the theatre layer by its own law. The city holds together on mandate and momentum, and the mandate is four years old.

NOW: the city moves at night the way it always has — through Midtown corridors and Wall Street boardrooms, the theatre district's registered touchstones, the family's estate offices, the Upper West Side's reduced chantry, the waterfront's guarded industrial blocks, the tolerated boroughs' community meetings, and the 245 miles of tunnel where Maddox's people hear everything first. The working group reads the transactions and waits for pattern. The instruments hold the peace between the polities. The Discipline holds the city to a rule it complies with by its own politics. And in Greenpoint, a Bishop who was old when the Sword was young keeps a correspondence the Prince cannot stop and a campaign that cannot finish. Whoever keeps the Masquerade, the Discipline and the instruments keeps New York. Whoever breaks one meets the joint working group — or the Prince, whose word ends every question, and whose mandate says the question was already settled.
